messages.Unghiul θ se măsoară în sens trigonometr: Angle θ is measured counterclockwise from the positive x-axis. Point P has coordinates (cos θ, sin θ) because the circle has radius 1.
messages.Într-un triunghi dreptunghic, pentru un: In a right triangle, the ratios of its sides for an acute angle θ are called trigonometric functions. On the unit circle (r = 1), these definitions become coordinates.
messages.Pe cercul unitate, P(cos θ; sin θ). Func: On the unit circle, P(cos θ, sin θ). The functions are periodic and extend to any angle, not just acute angles.
messages.Prima relație este teorema lui Pitagora: The first identity is the Pythagorean theorem on the unit circle: the legs are |sin θ| and |cos θ|, and the hypotenuse is the radius, 1.
messages.(180°). sin este impară, cos este pară:: (180°). Sine is odd and cosine is even: sin(−θ) = −sin θ, cos(−θ) = cos θ.
messages.Pentru un cerc de rază 1, unghiul θ și a: On a circle of radius 1, angle θ and the arc length have the same numerical value in radians. Point P has coordinates exactly (cos θ, sin θ), with no scale factor.
messages.Când θ crește uniform, P se rotește unif: As θ increases uniformly, P rotates uniformly. Its vertical projection oscillates between −1 and 1: this is simple harmonic motion.
messages.Un punct care se mișcă uniform pe un cer: A point moving uniformly around a circle has projections that oscillate sinusoidally. This is why trigonometric functions describe springs, pendulums and waves.
messages.Amplitudinea A este raza cercului, pulsa: Amplitude A is the circle's radius, angular frequency ω is its angular speed, and phase φ is its initial angle.
messages.Butonul de sunet redă un ton sinusoidal: The sound button plays a sine tone whose frequency increases with ω: the same waveform in the audio range.
messages.tan și cot nu au amplitudine: tan and cot have no amplitude
messages.Perioada este {period}° ({periodRad} rad: The period is {period}° ({periodRad} rad), so the graph repeats every {period}°. The amplitude is {amplitude}, and the phase shift is {shift}° relative to the base wave. The maximum is {max} and the minimum is {min}.
messages.Funcția {function} are perioada {period}: The {function} function has period {period}° ({periodRad} rad) and is undefined where its denominator is zero. Vertical asymptotes appear there, marked with dotted lines. Values grow without bound near the asymptotes.
messages.Tensiunea rețelei este o sinusoidă. Fazo: The mains voltage is sinusoidal. The phasor on the left rotates, and its vertical projection gives the instantaneous value.
messages.Tensiunea alternativă se scrie u(t) = U₀: Alternating voltage is written as u(t) = U₀·sin(ωt + φ), where U₀ is the peak value, ω = 2πf is the angular frequency, and φ is the initial phase. The RMS value is Uef = U₀/√2. For a 230 V mains supply, the peak is about 325 V.
messages.Poziția corpului față de echilibru este: The body's displacement from equilibrium is x(t) = A·sin(ωt + φ). As the phase increases, the body moves up and down and the graph traces a sine wave. Amplitude A is the maximum distance from equilibrium, and period T is the time for one complete oscillation.
messages.Componenta paralelă trage corpul în jos: The parallel component pulls the body down the slope, while the perpendicular component presses on the plane and produces the normal force N. Friction Ff = μ·N opposes the motion. If mg·sin α > μ·mg·cos α, the body accelerates downhill at a = g(sin α − μ·cos α).

messages.Funcțiile unghiurilor complementare se s: The trigonometric functions of complementary angles switch places.
messages.Tan x = sin x / cos x, definită când cos: tan x = sin x / cos x, defined when cos x ≠ 0. cot x is its reciprocal: cos x / sin x.
